insight.what: In a despairing fight against a mysterious pandemic, a scientist must choose whether to put his faith in science or the omens from his deceased wife that may well be humanity's last hope.
insight.problem: An experimental crossing between the genres of sci-fi, horror, mystery, and romance.
insight.audience: An exploration of how technologies and AI influence the human condition and psychology in the modern world, raising questions on faith and uncertainty. Are individuals getting more and more closed off? How can we connect and sympathize in a society where emotions are suppressed and undermined? How can we find the strength and passion to move forward through these trying times?
insight.process: Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini and Blackmagic Cinema Camera 6K, using Kolari Vision infrared filters. DaVinci Resolve, Logic Pro, and Avid Pro Tools for post-production.

credits.name: Ducanh Demen, Lê Vũ Xuân Anh

insight.what: This was a really fun one. MẢNH — a Vietnamese tradition-inspired fashion brand — reached out and said: “We have this very cool campaign coming up, and we want to show how we make it.”
insight.problem: Working with T R A G, founder of MẢNH, I got to understand the mind behind the clothes, her character, and the stories that shape her artistic personality. “Fashion should be experimental and distinct. I hope whoever wears my work finds comfort in it as they finally step out of their fashion comfort zone,” she told me. For this campaign, T R A G wrote and drew a one-shot comic — her own vision and take on the folklore “Tấm Cám,” an ancient story of two stepsisters filled with karma and the clash between good and evil. MẢNH clothing would be a representation of that.
insight.audience: I led the video production. Just showing “how we make it” wasn’t enough. I wanted to go beyond a simple behind-the-scenes piece and instead create a work-in-progress visualization of an evolving idea. The goal was to let the audience feel what it’s like to be “there” on set as the concept grows from a thought, to notes, to artworks, and finally to fashion pieces being worn.
insight.process: The big idea: “To Create is to Experience without Boundaries.” The concept sits at the intersection of art and tech, between cultural texts and contemporary media, between traditional craftsmanship and experimental execution, between storytelling and fashion. All of that comes together to represent one word: creativity.
insight.result: It was a deliberate creative choice to shoot this promo entirely on iPhone 17 Pro Max. With the iPhone, we could achieve angles and movements that would normally take much more setup with a standard camera. And that “iPhone” feel, it's just different.

credits.name: Future Cities Institute founded by CAIVAN

insight.what: The FCI Monthly News Recap: a carousel template for Instagram and LinkedIn, designed for the Future Cities Institute founded by CAIVAN during a 2025 co-op term as Communications Assistant.
insight.problem: How can stories on urban planning and research be transformed to make them more digestible and accessible to a wider audience?
insight.process: Drawing attention through colour — the University of Waterloo's brand palette — and through dynamics: lines, rounded shapes and typographic hierarchy that create the motivation for motion.
insight.result: A contribution to 63% higher impressions and 32.5% growth on LinkedIn in two months.
